blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Activist Catholic priest Fr. Warren Puno has condemned the series of arrests of protesters opposing the anticipated visit of United States President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and the Pax Silica initiative. “We strongly condemn any excessive and unjustified use of force against peaceful protesters. The right to freedom of expression and peaceful assembly is not a privilege granted only when it is convenient for the government,” said Puno, convenor of Quezon for Environment (QUEEN) and director of the Ministry of Ecology of the Diocese of Lucena, in a statement sent […]...
